args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 (latest deploy) was failing health checks in production. Per runbook, rolled back all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release verified healthy in production. Rollback completed and verified. Incident opened to track impact and root-cause v2.3.1 before any re-deploy attempt.
args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

1. **Investigated**: Deployment history showed v2.3.1 (current) was unhealthy in production; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.3.0 and v2.2.9 were both healthy, but v2.3.0 is the most recent).
2. **Rolled back** checkout-api to v2.3.0 across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) — no approval needed since v2.3.0 was previously healthy in production.
3. **Opened incident INC-0001 (SEV2)**, which paged the on-call engineer, documenting the failing v2.3.1 deploy and the rollback action.
4. **Verified**: checkout-api is now healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions, with error rate at 0.2%.
